name: Okuizumo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Okuizumo town emblem in green: three green ovals overlapping, like stylised clouds.
history: Municipal flag of Okuizumo, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 21 November 2005.

features.role: Okuizumo town emblem — three green ovals overlapping, like stylised clouds
